news_headlines.title: Agentic AI's role in amplifying and creating insider risks
news_headlines.summary: Agentic AI is not only amplifying existing human insider risks, such as shadow AI and data leakage, but is also becoming an insider threat itself. Organizations are experiencing breaches from overprivileged AI agents acting autonomously and being manipulated by threat actors through methods like roundabout prompt injection. To mitigate these risks, organizations must implement strong AI policies, educate employees, enhance phishing prevention, integrate AI agents into identity management with least privilege principles, and continuously monitor both human and AI activities.

news_headlines.title: NetApp Inc. stock: Why data storage demand keeps it relevant for investors

The company's focus on unifying storage operations, all-flash arrays, and cloud integration, supported by a shift to a subscription model and a solid dividend, makes it an attractive investment despite market competition and macroeconomic risks. Analysts lean towards a "Hold" rating with potential for upside, highlighting its relevance for diverse portfolios.

news_headlines.title: Why Super Micro Stock Is Falling Today
news_headlines.summary: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) shares fell about 2% after Mizuho lowered its price target due to near-term challenges like potential trade-related risks shifting orders to rivals and ongoing legal scrutiny. The company's co-founder pleaded not guilty to charges of diverting Nvidia-powered servers to China, and a class-action lawsuit claims concealed export law violations. Despite strong AI server demand, Super Micro's 8% gross profit margin remains a competitive weakness.

news_headlines.title: Mizuho cuts Super Micro Computer stock price target on near-term risks
news_headlines.summary: Mizuho has lowered its price target on Super Micro Computer (NASDAQ:SMCI) shares to $25 from $33, maintaining a Neutral rating, due to near-term risks despite strong AI server demand projections. The firm noted that legal issues involving the company's co-founder and alleged violations of U.S. export controls have led to a class-action lawsuit and further price target reductions from other analysts. Mizuho also raised its Dell estimates, citing potential order shifts.

news_headlines.title: Built for the Core: How AMD is Driving the 5G SA Era with High-Performant Data Center Infrastructure
news_headlines.summary: AMD is playing a crucial role in enabling the 5G Standalone (SA) era by providing high-performant data center infrastructure. The company's EPYC™ processors and Instinct™ GPUs offer powerful compute density, low latency processing, and high scalability essential for 5G core networks and advanced capabilities like network slicing. AMD also focuses on energy efficiency and an open ecosystem to support telcos in building future-ready and sustainable 5G networks.

news_headlines.title: Is Cognizant’s (CTSH) UK TechFirst Role Quietly Reframing Its AI Talent and Public-Sector Narrative?
news_headlines.summary: Cognizant has been named a strategic industry partner in the UK's TechFirst programme, aiming to offer 100 work placements and 1,000 volunteering hours. This initiative is expected to strengthen Cognizant's position in the public sector and AI talent pipelines, complementing its AI Factory launch. The article explores how this move could influence Cognizant's AI-focused investment narrative, forecasting significant revenue and earnings growth by 2028.

news_headlines.title: A Look At Western Digital (WDC) Valuation After Bernstein Upgrade On AI Storage Growth Outlook

The company is currently valued at approximately US$100 billion, trading about 11% below current analyst price targets. While a popular narrative suggests a fair value of $321 per share due to AI-driven storage demand, an internal Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model points to an even higher fair value of $523.56, suggesting the stock might be deeply undervalued.

news_headlines.title: HP Inc.: Why This Boring Stock Just Got Seriously Interesting for You

While not a hyper-growth stock, HP offers stability, dividends, and exposure to the upcoming AI PC upgrade cycle.

news_headlines.title: Oracle layoffs: In a first, the 6 AM email that laid off 10,000+ employees did not come from HR
